item.title: Dangerous Speeding and Excessive Traffic Noise in Residential Area, 14th July
item.description:
Vehicles are regularly speeding up and down our residential road, creating excessive noise and disturbing residents, particularly between 3:00 am and 4:00 am. There appears to be a business nearby, and traffic associated with it is using our road at inappropriate speeds during the early hours of the morning. The constant acceleration and high speeds create a significant noise nuisance, making it difficult for residents to sleep. This is particularly concerning as our road has a 20 mph speed limit, which is more than adequate for a residential area. The speeding also raises serious safety concerns for residents, pedestrians and anyone using the road. We would appreciate the council investigating this issue and working with the police to consider appropriate traffic-calming measures or enforcement, such as occasional speed monitoring, to deter those driving recklessly. This is an ongoing issue that is affecting the quality of life for residents and would benefit from prompt attention.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Stoke Road, Bishop's Cleeve, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
